name: 85021 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85021 (Phoenix) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85021 (Phoenix) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
